title: Understanding the Vectors
text: The vectors $u_1$ and $u_2$ are given as columns of a matrix $U$. Consider what properties these vectors should have in the context of the SVD.

title: Orthogonality Check
text: In the context of SVD, the columns of the matrix $U$ should be orthogonal. Check if $u_1$ and $u_2$ are orthogonal.

title: Calculate the Dot Product
text: Calculate the dot product of $u_1$ and $u_2$. If the dot product is zero, the vectors are orthogonal.

title: Normalization Check
text: Each column vector in the matrix $U$ should be a unit vector. Check if $u_1$ and $u_2$ are unit vectors.

title: Calculate the Norm
text: Calculate the norm of $u_1$ and $u_2$. If the norm is $$1$$, the vector is a unit vector.

title: Conclusion
text: Based on the orthogonality and normalization checks, determine if the combination of $u_1$ and $u_2$ is valid.
